recorded_corrections.claim_retracted: During selection an intermediate report stated that the EU article candidates above 113 whose string appears in corpus text are exactly {114, 119}.

The full scan to 200 found a third: Article 188, once in nist_playbook normalized.txt and once in extracted.txt, in the references block nist_playbook:sub_MAP_2.2.references, which reads 'Proc. ACM Hum.-Comput. Interact. 5, CSCW1, Article 188 (April 2021), 21 pages.' An ACM proceedings article number, not a provision of any instrument.
recorded_corrections.blast_radius: None. No pick moves. Class A takes the lowest satisfying candidate and 114 is lowest, so a third member found at 188 cannot displace it. Class B's pick at 181 is below 188, so within Class B 188 can only ever be a skip, and it appears there with reason_code string_present_in_corpus_text. It also appears as a Class A not_lowest row, since it satisfies Class A without being the lowest candidate.
recorded_corrections.recorded_because: A claim stated more broadly than its evidence is a defect whether or not it changed an outcome, and a correction that changes nothing is the cheap kind to record.
